senses.gloss: अभ्य्-ऊ᳙ढि f. conveying towards, TBr.
अभ्य्-ऊ᳙ढि See अभि-√ वह्.
अभ्य्-अय m. approaching (as of darkness), KātyŚr.
setting (of the sun), ib.
अभ्य्-अय See 2. अभी.
अभ्य्-आ-√ या to come up to, approach, MBh. &c.
अभ्य्-आयुक mfn. coming up to (acc.), KapS.
अभ्य्-आयुक See 2. अभी.
अभ्य्-एषण n. (only for the explan. of अभिष्टि) approaching (either in a friendly or hostile manner), Sāy. on RV. vii, 19, 8 and i, 9, 1
desiring, wishing for, Sāy. on RV. i, 116, 11 and iv, 11, 4.
अभ्य्-एषण See अभीष्.
अभ्य्-एषणीय mfn. (only for the explan. of अभिष्टि) to be desired, Sāy. on RV. i, 119, 8.
अभ्य्-अग्नि m. N. of a son of Etaśa or Aitaśa, AitBr.; KauṣBr.
अभ्य्-अग्नि ind. towards the fire, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 14, Sch.
अभ्य्-अग्र mf(आ)n. having the point turned or directed towards (acc.), ĀpŚr.
quick, KauṣBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
constant, perpetual, Āp.
fresh (as blood), Bhaṭṭ.
near, L.
अभ्य्-अग्र n. proximity, L.
अभ्य्-अघाय Nom. P. -अघाय॑ति, to intend to injure, AV. vii, 70, 3.
अभ्य्-अङ्क mf(आ)n. recently marked (as cattle), Pāṇ. ii, 1, 14, Kāś.
अभ्य्-अज् (√ अज्), (Imper. or Subj. 1. du. -अ॑जाव) to combine, unite, RV. i, 179, 3.
अभ्य्-आज् (√ अज्), (Imper. 2. sg. -आज) to drive near, Pāṇ. viii, 1, 8, Sch.

अभ्य्-√ अञ्ज् P. to smear, anoint, TS.; AitBr. &c.:
Ā. to anoint one's self:
Ā. (3. pl. अभ्य् अ॑ञ्जते) to decorate, RV. ix, 86, 43 :
Ā. -अङ्क्ते॑, to decorate one's self, TS. (quoted in Pāṇ. ii, 3, 62, Kāś.);
 (in Pass. sense; p. -अञ्जान॑)
to be decorated, RV. ii, 8, 4.
अभ्य्-अ᳙क्त mfn. oiled, anointed, ŚBr.; Mn. iv, 44, &c.
decorated, AV. x, 1, 25.
अभ्य्-अङ्ग m. rubbing with unctuous substances, inunction, Mn. ii, 178, &c.
unguent, Suśr. &c.
अभ्य्-अञ्जक mfn. (ifc.) rubbing (the feet) with unctuous substances, Kathās.
अभ्य्-अ॑ञ्जन n. rubbing with unctuous substances, inunction (especially of the feet, once [BhP.] said of the hairs), KātyŚr.; Mn. &c.
unguent (used for rubbing the feet; cf. आ॑ञ्जन), ŚBr. &c.
(5) ornament, embellishment, RV.
अभ्य्-अञ्जन्य᳙ mfn. whose feet are to be rubbed with unguents, TBr.
अभ्य्-अञ्ज्य mfn. to be rubbed with unguents (as a foot), Kathās.
अभ्य्-अति-√ क्षर् (impf. -अक्षरत्) to flow over to (acc.), TBr.; AitBr.
अभ्य्-अतित mfn. (√ अत्), one who has walked towards (acc.), one who visits (used for the etym. of अतिथि), Nir.
अभ्य्-अतीत mfn. passed away (as time), MBh. iii, 12547
dead, Mn. iv, 252; MBh. vii, 1061.
अभ्य्-अति-√ नी to bring or place upon (loc.), Kauś.
अभ्य्-अति-√ रिच् Pass. -अ॑ति-रिच्-यते, or -अति-रिच्य॑ते (Subj. अभ्य्-अ॑ति-रि॑च्यातै; Pot. -अ॑ति-रिच्येत) Ved. to remain for the sake of (acc.), TS.; ŚBr. &c.
अभ्य्-अति-√ वद् P. (= अति-√ वद्, q.v.) ‘to speak louder or better’, surpass in disputing, PBr.
अभ्य्-अति-√ वृत् -वर्तते, to drive past, MBh. vii, 1391 (v.l.)
अभ्य्-अति-√ सृज् (1. pl. -अ॑ति-सृजामस्) to let pass, AV. x, 5, 15 = xvi, 1, 5.

अभ्य्-अती (√ इ), (ind.p. -अतीत्य) to pass over (acc.), R.;
to get through towards (acc.), ŚBr.
अभ्य्-अत्य्-√ ऋज् to carry over or transfer upon (acc.), AitBr.
अभ्य्-अधिक mf(आ)n. surpassing (in number, power, kind), R.
exceeding the common measure, pre-eminent, extraordinary, MBh. &c.
superior to, more excellent than, having more authority or power than, more than (abl. or instr. or in comp.), MBh. &c.
augmented by (abl. [VarBṛS.] or instr. or in comp.)
अभ्य्-अधिकम् ind. exceedingly, MBh. xiii, 580, &c.
अभ्य्-अधिकाधिक mfn. always or progressively increasing, Naiṣ.
अभ्य्-अध्ययन n. studying (the Veda &c.) at any place (comp.), Gaut.
अभ्य्-अध्वम् ind. upon the way, KātyŚr.
अभ्य्-अध्वे॑ ind. loc. on the way, AV. iv, 28, 2.
2. अभ्य्-अनुज्ञा f. (ifc. f(आ). ) assent, approval, Ragh. ii, 69; Nyāyad.
authorization, permission, RPrāt.; ĀśvGṛ.
granting leave of absence, dismissing, R. &c.
अभ्य्-अनुज्ञात mfn. assented to, approved, Mn. ii, 1
authorized, allowed to, MBh. &c.
(अन्- neg.), Mn. ii, 229
favoured by (instr.), R. iii, 36, 19
allowed to depart, dismissed, MBh. &c.
अभ्य्-अनुज्ञान n. assenting to, approval Comm. on Nyāyad.
authorization, permission, R. i, 3, 14.
अभ्य्-अनुज्ञापन n. causing to assent to.
अभ्य्-अनुज्ञेय mfn. to be admitted or assented to, Nyāyam.
अभ्य्-अनु-√ प्रछ् to inquire after, ask for, MBh. xii, 1933 and xiii, 2169.
अभ्य्-अनु-√ मुद् Caus. (perf. Pass. p. -मोदित; p. necess. -मोदनीय) to assent to, approve of MBh. i, 4447; Inscr.
अभ्य्-अनुमोदन n. agreement with, approval, Jātakam.
अभ्य्-अनु-√ युज् (ind.p. -युज्य) to apply to, ask, MBh. xii, 5667.

अभ्य्-अनु-√ वच् (perf. -अनूवाच) to declare or state or utter with reference to (acc.), AitBr. :
Pass. (3. pl. -अनूच्यन्ते) to be referred to by some statement or verse, ŚBr.
अभ्य्-अनूक्त mfn. stated or uttered with reference to (acc.), ŚBr.; AitBr.; ChUp. (cf. अभ्युक्त.)
अभ्य्-अनु-√ वद् P. (= अभ्य्-अनु-√ वच्) to utter with reference to (acc.), ŚBr.
अभ्य्-अनु-√ शास् (Imper. 1. p. -शासानि) to indicate, denote, ChUp.
अभ्य्-अनु-√ सृ (ind.p. -सृत्य v.l. -सृज्य) to learn by investigating, Hariv. 1440.
अभ्य्-अनु-√ सृज् (ind.p. -सृज्य) id., ib.
अभ्य्-अन्तर mf(आ)n. interior, being inside of, included in (loc.; gen. or in comp. [cf. गणाभ्यन्तर]), MBh. ii, 2282, &c.
initiated in, conversant with (loc.), R.; Megh.
next, nearly related, intimate, Pañcat.
अभ्य्-अन्तर m. ‘on intimate terms’, a lover, Divyāv.
अभ्य्-अन्तर n. inner part, interior, inside, middle, Śāk. &c.
(generally loc.; ifc.) interval, space of time, Mṛcch.; Pañcat.; Hit.
आभ्यन्तर mfn. (fr. अभ्य्-अन्तर), being inside, interior, inner, MBh.; Suśr.
अभ्य्-अन्तरम् ind. (ifc.) into, Kathās. &c.
आभ्यन्तरम् ind. inside.
अभ्य्-अन्तर—कला f. pl. the secret arts or the arts of coquetry, Daś.
अभ्य्-अन्तर—चारिन् mfn. moving inside, Bhag.
अभ्य्-अन्तर—तस् ind. in the interior, inwards, Suśr.
अभ्य्-अन्तर—दोष-कृत् mfn. ‘doing a wrong to one's own land’, raising a sedition or mutiny, VarBṛS.
अभ्यन्तरायाम m. curvature of the spine by spasm, emprosthotonos, Suśr. (cf. बाह्यायाम.)
अभ्य्-अन्तरक m. an intimate friend, L.
अभ्यन्तरी (for अभ्यन्तर in comp. with √ 1. कृ and its derivatives).
अभ्यन्तरी—करण n. initiating in (loc.), Daś.
अभ्यन्तरी—√ कृ to put between, insert, Pat.
अभ्यन्तरी—कृत mfn. initiated in (loc.), R.
made intimate, Pañcat.

अभ्य्-अप-√ क्रम् -क्रम्, -क्रामति, to go away towards (acc.), ŚBr.;
 (aor. Subj. 2. sg. -अ॑पक्रमीस्) to come up to, AV. xii, 2, 18.
अभ्य्-अप-√ श्रि Ā. to retire towards (acc.), ṢaḍvBr.
अभ्य्-अपान् (√ अन्) to breathe towards (acc.), AitBr.

अभ्य्-√ अम् अभ्य्-अ᳙मीति (VS. [quoted in Pāṇ. vii, 2, 34, Sch.; cf. also, ib. 3, 95, Sch.]; 2. sg. -अ᳙मीषि; 3. pl. Subj. -अम॑न्ति and impf. Ā. -अ॑मन्त) to advance violently against, pain, hurt, RV. i, 189, 3; vii, 25, 2 and x, 86, 8; VS.
अभ्य्-अमन n. paining, oppression, Nir.
अभ्य्-अमन—वत् mfn. paining, hurting, ib.
अभ्य्-अमित or अभ्यान्त mfn. (perf. Pass. p.) diseased, sick, L.
अभ्य्-अमित or अभ्यान्त mfn. (perf. Pass. p.) diseased, sick, L.
अभ्य्-आन्त = अभ्य्-अमित, q.v.

अभ्य्-अमित्रीण [Bhaṭṭ.] or ˚त्रीय or ˚त्र्य [Bhaṭṭ.], mfn. [apparently derivatives fr. अभ्य्-अमित्रम् (see below s.v.), but probably originally derived from the rt., which is also indicated by the parallel form अभ्य्-अमिन् (see below)] advancing against or attacking (the enemy), Pāṇ. v, 2, 17.
अभ्य्-अमित्रीण &c. See अभ्य्-√ अम्.

अभ्य्-अमित्रीण [Bhaṭṭ.] or ˚त्रीय or ˚त्र्य [Bhaṭṭ.], mfn. [apparently derivatives fr. अभ्य्-अमित्रम् (see below s.v.), but probably originally derived from the rt., which is also indicated by the parallel form अभ्य्-अमिन् (see below)] advancing against or attacking (the enemy), Pāṇ. v, 2, 17.

अभ्य्-अमित्रीण [Bhaṭṭ.] or ˚त्रीय or ˚त्र्य [Bhaṭṭ.], mfn. [apparently derivatives fr. अभ्य्-अमित्रम् (see below s.v.), but probably originally derived from the rt., which is also indicated by the parallel form अभ्य्-अमिन् (see below)] advancing against or attacking (the enemy), Pāṇ. v, 2, 17.
अभ्य्-अमित्रीण-ता f. a good opportunity to attack the enemy, Rājat.
अभ्य्-अमिन् mfn. attacking, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 157.
अभ्य्-अमित्र (basis of अभ्य्-अमित्रम् and its derivatives ˚त्रीण, &c.), Pāṇ. v, 2, 17
अभ्य्-अमित्रम् ind. against the enemy, Veṇīs.
अभ्य्-अयोध्यम् ind. towards or against Ayodhyā, Bhaṭṭ.
अभ्य्-अरि ind. towards or against the enemy, L.
अभ्य्-अर्कबिम्बम् ind. towards the disk of the sun, Śāk.
अभ्य्-अर्चन n. worship, reverence, Mn. ii, 176, &c.
अभ्य्-अर्चनीय mfn. = अभ्य्-अर्च्य.
अभ्य्-अर्चा f. = अभ्य्-अर्चन above, L.
अभ्य्-अर्चित mfn. reverenced, MBh. ii, 1390, &c.
incorrectly for अभ्य्-अर्थित, MBh. v, 1532.
अभ्य्-अर्च्य mfn. to be reverenced, VarBṛS. &c.
अभ्य्-अर्ण mfn. (fr. √ ऋ, or according to Pāṇ. vii, 2, 25 fr. √ अर्द्, in which case it should be written अभ्य्-अर्ण्ण) near, proximate, Ragh. ii, 32, &c.
अभ्य्-अर्ण n. proximity, Mālatīm. &c.
अभ्य्-अर्ण See s.v., p. 76, col. 1.
अभ्य्-अर्ण्ण mfn. (as नि-षण्ण fr. नि-षद्). See अभ्य्-अर्ण.
अभ्य्-अर्ण—ता f. proximity, Kād.

अभ्य्-√ अर्त् (aor. Ā. 2. pl. -अर्तिढ्वम्) [NBD.] incorrectly for अभ्य्-√ अर्थ्, PBr.;
 cf. अन्वर्त् (अन्व्-अर्त्?).
अभ्य्-अर्थन n. asking, requesting
अभ्य्-अर्थना generally (आ) f. id., Kum. i, 53, &c.
अभ्य्-अर्थनीय mfn. to be requested or asked.
अभ्य्-अर्थित mfn. asked, invited, Mn. ii, 189, &c.
अभ्य्-अर्थित n. request, Yājñ. ii, 88 (cf. यथाभ्यर्थित.)
अभ्य्-अर्थिन् mfn. (ifc.) asking, Kathās.
1. अभ्य्-अर्थ्य mfn. = अभ्य्-अर्थनीय.
2. अभ्य्-अर्थ्य ind.p. asking, requesting, Kathās.

अभ्य्-√ अर्द् to oppress, afflict, pain, R. :
Caus. id., BhP.
अभ्य्-अर्दित mfn. (fr. Caus.) distressed, oppressed, MBh. i, 4116; Pāṇ. vii, 2, 25, Sch.
अभ्य्-अर्˚ध॑ m. only (ए॑) loc. ind. opposite to, in the face of (abl.), ŚBr.
अभ्य्-अर्ध॑म् ind. beside, apart from (abl.), MaitrS.
अभ्य्-अर्ध—य॑ज्वन् (6) mfn. (said of Pūṣan) receiving sacrifices apart or separate ones, RV. vi, 50, 5.
अभ्य्-अर्ध॑स् ind. apart, separate from (abl.), MaitrS.; TS.
अभ्य्-अर्हण n. reverencing, honouring, BhP.
अभ्य्-अर्हणीय mfn. to be greatly honoured, venerable.
अभ्य्-अर्हणीय—ता f. honourableness, Mn. ix, 23.
अभ्य्-अर्हित mfn. greatly honoured, venerable, Kād. (cf. Pāṇ. ii, 2, 34 Comm.)
more honoured, Kād.
more important than (abl.)
fit, proper, becoming, L.
अभ्य्-अलंकृत mfn. decorated, R. iii, 53, 36.
अभ्य्-अलंकार m. (ifc. f(आ). ), decoration, MBh. iii, 16166.
अभ्य्-अल्प mfn. very small, AitBr.
अभ्य्-√ अव् (aor. -आवीत्) to refresh, RV. ix, 97, 35.
अभ्य्-अवकर्षण n. (√ कृष्), extraction, drawing out, L.
अभ्य्-अवकाश m. (√ काश्), an open space, Kauś.

अभ्य्-अव-कीर्ण mfn. covered, R.
अभ्य्-अव-√ क्रन्द् to call out towards (acc.), Kāṭh.
अभ्य्-अव-√ गाह् Caus. to ride or walk (horses) into the ford Comm. on TBr.
to enter, Divyāv.

अभ्य्-अव-√ चर् (Subj. 3. pl. -च॑रान्) to approach, assail, ŚBr. :
Caus. (Opt. -चारयेत्) to send away, MBh. xii, 3779.
अभ्य्-अव-√ ज्वल् Caus. -ज्वालयते, to enlighten, illumine, GopBr.

अभ्य्-अव-√ तन् -तनोति, to send out or spread (as rays instr.) towards (acc.), ŚBr. :
Pass. (3. pl. -तायन्ते) to be sent out or spread (as rays) towards (acc.), ŚBr.
1. अभ्य्-अव-√ 1. दा to place into (loc.), Car.

अभ्य्-अव-दुग्ध mfn. that upon which milk has been milked, Kauś.
अभ्य्-अव-√ धा (perf. Pass. p. -हित) to allay, lay (as dust), R. ii, 40, 33.
अभ्य्-अव-√ नम् Caus. (ind.p. -नाम्य) to bow, incline, MBh. iii, 10062.

अभ्य्-अव-√ नी to lead down (into water), ŚBr.; AitBr.;
 (perf. -निनाय) to pour into or upon (acc.), AitBr.; PBr.
अभ्य्-अव-√ पत् to fly near, AitBr.
अभ्य्-अवपात m. gravitation, Bcar. xii, 24.
1. अभ्य्-अव-√ मन् -मन्यते, to despise, reject, Mn. iv, 249.

अभ्य्-अव-√ रुह् to step down upon, ŚBr.;
 (perf. p. -रूढवत्), R. v, 52, 15.

Caus. P. to turn towards or to this side, ŚBr.
अभ्य्-अव-√ सृ (ind.p. -सृत्य) to retire from (abl.) towards (acc.), MBh. vii, 8479.

to meet, encounter, MBh. iv, 1549.

अभ्य्-अव-√ स्यन्द् to drive (on a carriage) towards, ŚBr.

taking food, eating, Viṣṇus. Comm. on Yājñ.

food, R.
अभ्य्-˚अवहृत mfn. eaten, L.

अभ्य्-अवहार्य mfn. eatable, R.; Pāṇ., Sch. and Comm.
अभ्य्-अवहार्य n. [Vikr.] or (आणि) n. pl. [MBh.] food, eating.

अभ्य्-अवा॑यन n. going down, ŚBr.

अभ्य्-असन n. practice, exercise, R. &c.

reduplication, Nir.
repetition, Mn. xii, 74, &c.

war, battle, L.

enmity, L.

अभ्य्-उदय m. sunrise or rise of luminaries (during or with reference to some other occurrence), KātyŚr.; Jaim.
beginning, commencing (as of darkness, &c.), R.
elevation, increase, prosperity, happiness, good result, Mn. iii, 254; R. &c.
a religious celebration, festival, Mn. ix, 84.
अभ्य्-उदयावह m. bringing prosperity, Bcar.
अभ्युदयेष्टि f. N. of an expiatory sacrifice, Jaim. (cf. अभ्युदितेष्टि.)
अभ्य्-उदयिन् mfn. rising, Rājat.
1. अभ्य्-उदित mfn. risen (as the sun or luminaries), MBh.; R.; Mn. iv, 104
one over whom (while sleeping) the sun has risen, Mn. ii, 221 Comm. on TS.
engaged in combat, MBh. iii, 15362
arisen, happened
elevated, prosperous
अभ्यु॑दित n. (said of the sun or the moon) rising (during some other occurrence), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
2. अभ्य्-उदित mfn. (√ वद्), expressed (in words), KenaUp. (अन्- neg.)
See अभि-√ वद्.
अभ्य्-उदिता f. N. of the ceremony (to be performed at the अभ्यु॑दित), KauṣBr.
अभ्य्-उदित—शायि-ता f. the state of lying asleep while the sun has risen, MBh. xiii, 5093.
अभ्युदितेष्टि f. = अभ्युदयेष्टि, KauṣBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
अभ्य्-उद्-√ ईक्ष् Ā. (impf. -ऐक्षत) to look towards (acc.), R.

अभ्य्-उद्-√ ईर् Caus. (p. -ईरयत्) to raise (one's voice), MBh. i, 2570 :
Pass. -ईर्यते, to be stirred up, be intensified, Suśr.
अभ्य्-उदीरित mfn. ‘raised (as the voice), said’
अभ्य्-उदीरि˚ते ind. loc. after it had been said by (instr.), Kathās.
अभ्य्-उद्-√ 1. ऊह् (impf. औहत्) to move or push farther out, AitBr.
अभ्य्-उद्-ए (√ इ), (ind.p. -ए॑त्य) to go out in order to meet any one (acc.), AV. xv, 11, 2 and 12, 2.
अभ्य्-उद्ग mfn. fr. √ उब्ज्, Pat. on Pāṇ. Śivasūtra 5 and viii, 3, 38.
अभ्य्-उद्-√ 1. गा (aor. 2. sg. -अ॑गास्, 3. sg. -उ॑द्-अगात्) to rise over or during (acc.), RV. viii, 93, 4; ŚBr.
अभ्य्-उद्-गत mfn. risen (as the moon)
one who has gone out in order to meet any one (acc.), MBh. i, 3572
extended (as fame), R.; Lalit.
अभ्य्-उद्-गत—राज m. N. of a Kalpa, Buddh.
अभ्य्-उद्गति f. going to meet, Daś.
अभ्य्-उद्गम m. rising from a seat to honour any one, Kathās.
अभ्य्-उद्गमन n. id., L.
अभ्य्-उद्-√ दिश् to point at anything above with reference to, MānGṛ.
अभ्य्-उद्-दृष्ट mfn. having become visible (as the moon) during anything, KātyŚr.
अ॑न्- (neg.), one during the sacrifice of whom the moon has not become visible, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
अभ्य्-उद्दृष्टा f. N. of a ceremony, KauṣBr.
अभ्य्-उद्दृष्टेष्टि f. N. of a ceremony (beginning only after the moon has become visible), KauṣBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
अभ्य्-उद्-√ 2. द्रु -द्र॑वति, to run up to (acc.), TBr.
अभ्य्-उद्द्रवण n. running forth, TBr., Sch.
अभ्य्-उद्-धा (√ 2. हा) Ā. (3. pl. -उज्जिहते) to rise together with, ChUp.
अभ्य्-उद्धरण n. (MBh.)
अभ्य्-उद्धार m. (Divyāv.) rescuing, deliverance.
अभ्य्-उद्धृत mfn. taken up, &c.
drawn (as water), Yājñ. i, 17
collected (for a purpose), Mṛcch.
अभ्य्-उद्-यत mfn. (√ यम्), raised, lifted up, MBh. &c.
offered, Mn. iv, 247 seq.
prepared for, engaged in, ready for (Inf. [Hariv. &c.] or dat. [VarBṛS.] or loc. [Mn. ix, 302] or in comp. [Megh.])
(for अभ्य्-उद्गत), received kindly, welcomed, BhP.
अभ्य्-उन्नत mfn. (√ नम्), raised, elevated, VarBṛS.; Śāk. &c.
अभ्य्-उन्-√ नी to pour upon, scoop towards, ŚBr.; PBr.; Lāṭy.
अभ्य्-उन्मोदनीय mfn. to be assented to or acquiesced in Col.
अभ्य्-उपगत mfn. gone near to, approached, arrived at
agreed, assented to, admitted, MBh.; Śāk. &c.
अभ्य्-उपा-गत mfn. come near, approached, Lalit.
(with व्यसनाय, said of a sad fate), R.
अभ्य्-उपगन्तव्य mfn. to be gone to or set out for (dat.), MBh. xiv, 327
to be assented to or agreed upon, Pāṇ. i, 2, 55, Kāś.
to be admitted Comm. on Bād. and on Nyāyam.
अभ्य्-उपगन्तृ mfn. one who assents or admits Comm. on ChUp.
अभ्य्-उपगम m. going near to, approaching, arriving at, L.
an agreement, contract, Mn. ix, 53
assenting to, admitting, Sāh. &c.
(as a statement) Comm. on Bād.
अभ्य्-उपगम—सिद्धान्त m. an admitted axiom, Nyāyad.
अभ्य्-उपगमित mfn. ‘made to consent’, obtained by assent or free consent (as a slave for a fixed term) Comm. on Yājñ.

अभ्य्-उप-√ धा -उ॑प-दधाति, to place upon, TS.;
to cover with (instr.), ŚBr. : P. Ā. (3. pl. -उ॑प-दधति, Subj. 1. pl. -द॑धामहै) to place upon (the fire) in addition or together with, ŚBr.
अभ्य्-उप-नि-√ वृत् to return, be repeated, KauṣBr.
अभ्य्-उपपत्ति f. approaching in order to assist, protection, defence (ifc. [Mn.; Daś.] or with gen. [MBh. i, 112])
favour, the conferring of a benefit or kindness
agreement, assent Comm. on Nyāyad.
impregnation of a woman (especially of a brother's widow, as an act of duty), L.
(also) confession of faith, Divyāv.
अभ्य्—˚उपपत्तृ m. one who approaches to help, Car.
अभ्य्-उपपन्न mfn. protected, rescued
asking for protection or help, Mṛcch.
agreed to, admitted
agreeing to.
अभ्य्—˚उपपादन n. coming to aid, Daś.
अभ्य्-उप-√ मन्त्र् (impf. -मन्त्रयत्) to address with a formula, MBh. viii, 4720.

अभ्य्-उप-√ या to approach, go towards (acc. or dat.), MBh. vii, 1967; R.;
 (with शमम्) to enter the state of rest, MārkP.
अभ्य्-उपा-√ या to come up to, approach, Kathās.
अभ्य्-उपाय m. an agreement, promise, engagement, Āp.

अभ्य्-उपयुक्त mfn. (√ युज्), employed, used Comm. on Pat.
अभ्य्-उप-√ लक्ष् (perf. Pass. p. -लक्षित) to perceive, notice, R. v, 28, 11.

to sit down, Rājat.
अभ्य्-उप-शान्त mfn. (√ शम्), allayed, calmed.
अभ्य्-उप-√ सद् Caus. (ind.p. -साद्य) to reach (as a town).
अभ्य्-उप-√ सृ to come near, R.
अभ्य्-उप-√ सेव् -सेवते, to observe religiously, MBh. iii, 13432.

अभ्य्-उप-√ स्था to honour, BhP. :
Caus. to cause to bring near, R. iv, 38, 28.
अभ्य्-उप-स्थित mfn. come, arrived, Kathās.
attended or accompanied by (instr.), MBh. iii, 16132.

अभ्य्-उपा-√ कृष् to draw towards one's self, BhP.
अभ्य्-उपा-√ 1. दा (ind.p. -दाय) to pick up (as fruits from the ground), MBh. xii, 672.

अभ्य्-उपाव-√ हृ -उपा॑व-हर-ति, to bring or set down upon (acc.), ŚBr.;
to lower (as one's arms, बाहू॑), VS. x, 25; ŚBr.
अभ्य्-उपा-√ वृत् -उपा॑-वर्तते (also P. aor. Subj. 1. and 3. sg. -उपा॑-वृतम्, -उपा॑-वृतत्) to turn one's self or go towards (acc.), TS.; ŚBr.; AitBr.
अभ्य्-उपा॑-वृत्त mfn. turned or gone towards (acc.), ŚBr.
returned, R.
अभ्य्-उपा-√ हृ (impf. -उपाहरत्, which might also be -उपाहरत् fr. अभ्य्-उप-√ हृ) to bring near, offer, MBh. xv, 11.
2. अभ्य्-उपे (-उपा √ इ), (Imper. 2. sg. -उपैहि) to approach (for refuge, शरणम्), R. vi, 9, 39.
अभ्य्-उपायन n. a complimentary gift, an inducement, BhP.
अभ्य्-उपेत mfn. approached, arrived at (acc.), MBh. i, 3592; Ragh. v, 14
(with गृहम्) staying in a house, VarBṛS.
furnished with (in comp. [VarBṛS.] or instr.)
agreed upon, assented to, Daś.
promised, Megh.
अभ्य्-उपेतव्य mfn. to be admitted or assented to Comm. on Nyāyam.
अभ्य्-उपेत्य ind.p. having arrived at (acc.)
having entered, Nir.
having assented or agreed to.
अभ्युपेत्याशुश्रूषा f. breach of a contracted service, a title of law treating of disputes between the master and a servant who has broken his agreement Comm. on Yājñ. ii, 182 seqq.
अभ्य्-उपेयिवस् mf(युषी)n. (perf. p.) having approached, arrived at (acc.), R.; Bhaṭṭ.
having admitted, RPrāt. (see 1. अभ्य्-उपे).
अभ्य्-उपेक्ष् (√ ईक्ष्), (perf. p. -उपेक्षितवत्) to overlook, allow, MBh. xvi, 160.
अभ्य्-उल्लसत् mfn. (√ लस्), gleaming, flashing, Śiś. v, 2.
अभ्य्-√ उष् (impf. 3. pl. -उष्ण॑न्; Ved. Inf. -उषस्) to burn, consume by fire, RV. ix, 97, 39; Kāṭh.
अभ्य्-उष or अभ्य्-ऊष or अभ्य्-ओष, अस्, m. a kind of cake of grain &c. (half dressed, slightly scorched, or parched so as to be eaten from the hand), (g. अपूपादि, q.v.)
अभ्य्-उष or अभ्य्-ऊष or अभ्य्-ओष, अस्, m. a kind of cake of grain &c. (half dressed, slightly scorched, or parched so as to be eaten from the hand), (g. अपूपादि, q.v.)
अभ्य्-ऊष See अभ्य्-उष.
अभ्य्-उष or अभ्य्-ऊष or अभ्य्-ओष, अस्, m. a kind of cake of grain &c. (half dressed, slightly scorched, or parched so as to be eaten from the hand), (g. अपूपादि, q.v.)
अभ्युषीय or अभ्यूषीय or अभ्युष्य or अभ्यूष्य or अभ्य्-ओषीय or अभ्य्-ओष्य, mfn. consisting of, or belonging to, or fit for the above cake or preparation of parched grain, (g. अपूपादि, q.v.)
अभ्युषीय or अभ्यूषीय or अभ्युष्य or अभ्यूष्य or अभ्य्-ओषीय or अभ्य्-ओष्य, mfn. consisting of, or belonging to, or fit for the above cake or preparation of parched grain, (g. अपूपादि, q.v.)
अभ्युषीय or अभ्यूषीय or अभ्युष्य or अभ्यूष्य or अभ्य्-ओषीय or अभ्य्-ओष्य, mfn. consisting of, or belonging to, or fit for the above cake or preparation of parched grain, (g. अपूपादि, q.v.)
अभ्युषीय or अभ्यूषीय or अभ्युष्य or अभ्यूष्य or अभ्य्-ओषीय or अभ्य्-ओष्य, mfn. consisting of, or belonging to, or fit for the above cake or preparation of parched grain, (g. अपूपादि, q.v.)

अभ्युषीय or अभ्यूषीय or अभ्युष्य or अभ्यूष्य or अभ्य्-ओषीय or अभ्य्-ओष्य, mfn. consisting of, or belonging to, or fit for the above cake or preparation of parched grain, (g. अपूपादि, q.v.)
अभ्य्-उष्ट-मिश्र॑ mfn. partly burnt, ŚBr.
अभ्य्-उषित mfn. (√ 5. वस्), having dwelt, having passed the night with, R. iii, 17, 2.

अभ्य्-√ ऊर्णु अभ्य्-ऊ॑र्णोति (Imper. 2. sg. -ऊर्णुहि) to cover, conceal, RV. viii, 79, 2 and x, 18, 11; AV. : Ā. -ऊर्णुते॑ (p. f. -उर्ण्वाना॑) to cover or conceal one's self, AV. xiv, 1, 27; RV. v, 41, 19.
अभ्य्-ऊष—खादिका f. ‘eating of अभ्यूष-grains’, N. of a play, Vātsyāy.
1. अभ्य्-√ 1. ऊह् to cover with (instr.), TS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
2. अभ्य्-√ 2. ऊह् Ā. aor. -औहिष्ट, (p. -ओ॑हसान) to watch for, lie in ambush for (acc.), RV. vi, 17, 8 and 9 : P. -ऊहति, to infer, guess, Nir.
अभ्य्-ऊढ mfn. concluded, inferred, Nir.
अभ्य्-ऊह m. reasoning, deduction, inference, conjecture, Nir.; Mālatīm.
अभ्य्-ऊहितव्य mfn. to be inferred, Nir.
1. अभ्य्-ऊह्य mfn. id., L.
2. अभ्य्-ऊह्य ind.p. having deduced by reasoning, having inferred, Suśr.; Pāṇ. vii, 4, 23, Kāś. &c.
अभ्य्-√ ऋ -ऋणोति (perf. 3. pl. अभ्य्-आ॑रुः) to run towards, reach, RV. i, 35, 9 and iii, 1, 4.

अभ्य्-√ ऋछ् -अर्छति, to come to, visit or afflict with, MBh. iii, 11875;
 (impf. -आर्छत्) to strive against (acc.), strive to overpower, MBh. iii, 11726.
अभ्य्-√ ऋञ्ज् Ā. -ऋज्यते (P. pr. p. -ऋ॑ज्यत्) to stretch out the hand for, hasten towards (acc.), RV. i, 140, 2 and vi, 37, 3.
अभ्य्-√ ऋष् See अभ्य्-√ अर्ष्.
अभ्य्-ए (√ इ), -आ॑यति [RV. viii, 55, 1] or -ऐ॑ति [VS.], to go near, come to, approach, RV. &c.
अभ्य्-एत्य ind.p. having approached, N. Pañcat. &c.
आभ्यन्तर-नृत्त n. perfect dancing (according to the Nāṭya-śāstras), L.
आभ्यन्तर—प्रयत्न m. internal effort (of the mouth in producing articulate utterance) Comm. on Pāṇ. i, 1, 9; Siddh. p. 10.
आभ्यन्तरिक mfn. = आभ्यन्तर.
आभ्यवकाशिक mfn. (fr. अभ्य्-अवकाश), living in the open air, Buddh.
आभ्यवहारिक mfn. (fr. अभ्य्-अवहार), supporting life, belonging to livelihood, T.
आभ्याशिक mfn. (fr. अभ्य्-आश), being near to each other, neighbouring, MBh. (less correctly in this sense written आभ्यासिक).
आभ्यासिक mfn. (fr. अभ्य्-आस), resulting from practice, practising, repeating, L.
आभ्युदयिक mfn. (fr. अभ्य्-उदय), connected with the beginning or rising of anything, Mn.
relating to or granting prosperity, Mṛcch.; Uttarar. &c.
आभ्युदयिक n. N. of a Śrāddha or offering to ancestors on occasions of rejoicing, ĀśvŚr.; Gaut.; Gobh. &c.
